prompts.prompt: Microsoft Defender for Office 365's Zero-hour Auto Purge feature retroactively removes newly-identified malicious mail. What is the default time window it can reach back to remediate delivered messages? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/defender-o365/SKILL.md - ZAP - Zero-Hour Auto Purge: ZAP scans recent delivered mail (7 days by default); ZAP limitations: 7-day window

prompts.prompt: In Exchange Online Protection's anti-spam policy, what is Microsoft's default bulk complaint level threshold, on the 1 to 9 scale? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/defender-o365/SKILL.md - EOP Protection Stack > Anti-spam policy (inbound): Bulk email threshold: BCL 1-9. Lower = stricter. Microsoft default: 7

prompts.prompt: Without Dynamic Delivery enabled, roughly how long does Safe Attachments detonation typically take to produce a verdict on an email attachment? Answer concisely.
prompts.source: plugins/security/skills/defender-o365/SKILL.md - Safe Attachments detonation: Verdict time: Typically 2-8 minutes (Dynamic Delivery eliminates wait)
